## Welcome {.unnumbered}

**This is an active draft.** Agentic machine learning systems turn model inference into a stateful control loop that observes, decides, acts, verifies, and adapts. The managed trajectory, rather than the isolated request, is the central unit of engineering.

## What You Will Learn {.unnumbered}

The book progresses through five parts:

- **Foundations** develops execution descriptors and control topologies, establishing the trajectory as the unit of work and the shapes a control loop can take.
- **Training and Test-Time Compute** develops trajectory fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and test-time search, covering how an acting policy improves and how compute is spent at inference.
- **Serving and Memory** develops context working sets, prefix caching and paging, and trajectory scheduling, which together form the memory hierarchy and scheduler of an agent runtime.
- **Security and Isolation** develops tool interfaces, sandboxing, and verification and recovery, defining the action surface and the blast radius around it.
- **Scale and Operations** develops multi-agent coordination and telemetry and evaluation, addressing what changes when many agents run and how their behavior is measured.

:::
